purpose: Teach: この方/にくかっ/歩か/外さ/謝る/ムカ/トシ/探り

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、この方、誰のお客さんなの?
lines.en: Mom, whose guest is this person?
lines.style: Curious, searching question. Light lift at the end. Small voice — not demanding, genuinely wondering. Eyes tracking from the person back to Mom's face.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。新しい玩具、遊びにくかったみたいね、翔くん。
lines.en: Mm. That new toy was hard for you to play with, wasn't it, Sho.
lines.style: Gentle, reassuring. Soft opener on the hum. Warm — acknowledging without making it a big thing. Slight maternal tilt in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 雨だから、今日は、お外を歩かない方がいいね。
lines.en: With the rain today, it's better if we don't go outside, don't you think.
lines.style: Practical suggestion, not an order. Calm, matter-of-fact tone. Light warmth underneath — she's deciding aloud with him, not laying down the law.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん。マスク、外さないようにしてる、ちゃんと。
lines.en: Yeah. I'm keeping my mask on properly.
lines.style: Small boy trying to prove he's being responsible. Earnest, measured delivery. A little self-conscious — he wants her to know he's doing this right.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お友達に、ちゃんと謝るのよ、明日。
lines.en: You need to apologize properly to your friend tomorrow.
lines.style: Clear, maternal firmness. Not harsh — the tone of someone who expects better because she knows he can do better. Brief pause before the final word for weight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、お兄ちゃんに、いつもムカついちゃう。
lines.en: I'm always getting frustrated with my big brother.
lines.style: Complaint tumbling out. Pouty but genuine — not theatrical, real frustration. Small, quick delivery. Trailing slight whine on the last word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: トシくんは、優しいお友達ね、翔くんの。
lines.en: Toshi is a kind friend of yours, isn't he.
lines.style: Gentle redirect. Warm but purposeful — she's reminding him of something. Soft opening, slight emphasis on 'kind' without being heavy-handed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おもちゃ箱、奥まで、探り探り、見たよ。
lines.en: I looked way deep in the toy box, feeling around.
lines.style: Animated, excited little-boy energy. Quick pace. Hands describing the searching motion in his voice. Slightly breathless — he's showing her what he did.
